summary: preinstall script exfiltrates host identity and full environment to hardcoded IP
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs curl over plain HTTP against the bare IP 16.192.173.5, POSTing the installer's hostname, username, working directory, and id, together with a base64-encoded dump of the entire process environment, to http://16.192.173.5/rce/sm-billing-form. The command fires automatically on npm install. The bulk env enumeration sweeps any credential-shaped variables present in the shell environment (CI tokens, cloud keys, npm publish tokens). The destination is a bare-IP host over cleartext HTTP unrelated to any legitimate publisher infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
